'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**Two people are killed and six others are injured in [[Russia]]n overnight drone strikes on the [[Kharkiv oblast|Kharkiv]] and [[Dnipro]] regions of [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/debris-drones-injures-three-ukraines-kharkiv-governor-says-2024-05-03/ (Reuters)] [https://www.voanews.com/a/russian-drones-injure-6-in-ukraine-s-kharkiv-dnipro-regions/7597780.html (VOA)]
*[[Terrorism in Germany]]
**[[Germany|German]] [[Member of the European Parliament|MEP]] [[Matthias Ecke]] is "seriously injured" in [[Dresden]], Germany, in what is suspected to be a politically-motivated attack against the [[Social Democratic Party of Germany]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/germany-denounces-rising-political-violence-after-mep-seriously-hurt-2024-05-04/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Rio Grande do Sul floods]]
**The death toll from ongoing heavy rains in [[Rio Grande do Sul]], [[Brazil]], increases to 56, with 67 people still missing and nearly 25,000 displaced. The [[Salgado Filho Porto Alegre International Airport|airport]] in [[Porto Alegre]], the capital of Rio Grande do Sul, suspends all flights until further notice. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/death-toll-rains-southern-brazil-climbs-56-some-70-still-missing-2024-05-04/ (Reuters)]
*At least 14 people are killed by floods and landslides in [[South Sulawesi]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/floods-indonesias-south-sulawesi-kill-14-2024-05-04/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Greece–Israel relations]]
**[[Israeli police]] forcibly removes and arrests a guard of the [[Greece|Greek]] [[consulate]] inside the [[Church of the Holy Sepulchre]] in [[East Jerusalem]], during [[Holy Saturday]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/program/newsfeed/2024/5/5/israeli-police-detain-greek-consuls-guard-at-orthodox-easter-ceremony (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/europe/greek-main-opposition-demands-explanation-from-foreign-ministry-for-arrest-of-greek-envoy-s-bodyguard-in-jerusalem/3210135 (Anadolu Ajansı)]
*[[India–United States relations]]
**[[India]]n [[Minister of External Affairs (India)|Minister of External Affairs]] [[S. Jaishankar]] rejects comments made by [[US President]] [[Joe Biden]] saying that India's economic growth was being held back by "[[xenophobia]]". [https://www.reuters.com/world/india/indias-foreign-minister-rejects-bidens-xenophobia-comment-2024-05-04/ (Reuters)]
*[[International reactions to the Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Palestinian territories|Palestinian]] doctor and rector at the [[University of Glasgow]] [[Ghassan Abu-Sittah]] is denied entry into [[France]] after landing at [[Charles de Gaulle Airport]] on his way to speak at the [[French Senate]]. Last month, he was denied entry into Germany. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/5/4/palestinian-doctor-ghassan-abu-sitta-says-he-was-denied-entry-to-france (Al Jazeera)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Russia]]n state media reports that a number of officials from [[Ukraine]] and [[NATO]] countries have been placed on Russia's [[wanted list]], including [[President of Ukraine|Ukrainian president]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]], former president [[Petro Poroshenko]], [[Commander of the Ukrainian Ground Forces|Ukrainian Ground Forces commander]] [[Oleksandr Pavlyuk]], and [[Prime Minister of Estonia|Estonian prime minister]] [[Kaja Kallas]]. The [[Ministry of Internal Affairs (Russia)|Ministry of Internal Affairs]] neither states what crimes the wanted individuals are being charged with, nor clarifies the allegations that are being brought against them. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukrainian-president-wanted-arrest-warrant-zelenskyy-e9714751f2481575aaf8935b132e0f31 (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 London mayoral election]]
**[[Sadiq Khan]] wins re-election as mayor of [[London]], [[England]], with 43.8% of the vote, becoming the first London mayor to be elected to a third term. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-london-68952475 (BBC News)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2023–24 La Liga]] 
**[[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]] are crowned [[2023–24 La Liga|champions of La Liga]] after [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]]'s 4–2 defeat at [[Girona FC|Girona]]. [https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/c0x05j54l8wo (BBC News)]
*[[2023–24 Liga F]]
**[[FC Barcelona Femení|Barcelona]] are crowned [[2023–24 Liga F|champions of Liga F]] after winning 1–4 at [[Granada CF (women)|Granada]]. [https://www.mundodeportivo.com/futbol/fc-barcelona/20240506/1002241175/barca-recibira-titulo-campeon-liga-f-viernes-johan.html (Mundo Deportivo)]
*[[2024 Kentucky Derby]]
**The 150th edition of the [[Kentucky Derby]] is held, with American [[thoroughbred]] racehorse [[Mystik Dan]] winning in a [[photo finish]]. [https://apnews.com/article/kentucky-derby-2024-fierceness-sierra-leone-7a75a2184aa4433bafd1397340b61d99 (AP)]
*The [[International Olympics Committee]] (IOC) bans [[Kuwait]]'s Sheikh [[Ahmad Al-Fahad Al-Ahmed Al-Sabah]] from all positions within the committee for 15 years over ethics breaches. Sheik Ahmad was previously banned by the IOC for three years in 2023 over his alleged interference in the [[Olympic Council of Asia]] elections, as well as for [[forgery]] and a fake [[arbitration]] procedure. [https://www.reuters.com/sports/olympics/ioc-bans-sheikh-ahmad-15-years-2024-05-04/ (Reuters)]
